notes.content:

notes.title: Shredders FSR 3.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello shredders,

We hope you are all enjoying Glacier 🧊 and Shredding it to pieces.

We are super happy to announce that this new update brings [b]AMD FSR3.1[/b] to Shredders across all platforms.

This allows the game to run at roughly 25% higher frame rates with the same quality settings, especially on resolutions above 1080p, up to 4k. You can activate FSR 3.1 in the game options.

This update also contains a few bug fixes reported by the community in the last weeks.

Enjoy and have fun on the slopes,

The Shredders team

notes.title: Shredders’ Glacier update
notes.content:
[h1]Glacier — You Are Welcome![/h1]

It’s almost winter again, the most wonderful time of the year for us Shredders. It’s getting cold outside, nothing better than a good old session of Shredders with your friends to keep you warm… or not! Because we made the coldest, most insane Uber cool new zone: Glacier!

It has one of the longest top-to-bottom flow lines in Shredders, and one of the hardest-hitting, air-time, and versatile parks we have ever created. We poured our frozen hearts into it, and all we can say now is go enjoy it, pull your best moves, chill with your friends, land some massive tricks, and have fun! 

[previewyoutube=v51W7CHU8aA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Massive new zone: Glacier[/h3]
[list]
[*]Glacier is huge! One of the largest additions to Shredders yet, whether you like big natural kickers, groomed zones, or back-to-back park features, we’ve got you covered. It also comes with not just one new half-pipe, but two!
[*]8 new missions showcasing the new zone and allowing you to unlock new pro gear for this season.
[*]17 new hotspots through the Glacier area. 8 lines score, 2 rail contests, 3 best tricks, and 4 new time attacks!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/d2f82364708b322399d4bb78b2324fe058c554c8.png[/img]
[h3]New objects for the object dropper[/h3]
[list]
[*]Ball Feature
[*]Container
[*]High Arc Rail
[*]Flat Bar Rail
[*]Warning Sign
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/3b13259bc9edd68b79e9c5ee8ecdbcf3ba8144e0.png[/img]
[h3]Extra features[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now turn your character into a ragdoll at any time by pressing both triggers and shoulder buttons (it’s useless but it’s fun)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/92ea99d6caebc4cc2536a2b5aa65018d2c3495e0.png[/img]

notes.title: 540INDY Invitational
notes.content:
[h3]After the success of the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WRqmuPfBCiE&t=2254s]first edition[/url], we’re thrilled to announce the return of the 540INDY Invitational—the ultimate virtual snowboarding contest. Get ready for bigger air, gnarlier tricks, and even more stoke!

notes.title: Shredders 2024 Expansion
notes.content:
[h3]Crater Park — You Are Welcome![/h3]

The highly anticipated Crater Park is finally open. Playful, challenging, gigantic—it’s the biggest park we’ve ever built, and it’s free. As a thank you for all the love and support from our community. 🩵💚❤️🩷🧡 In addition to endless fun and exploration, Crater Park comes with 8 new missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/fe2bee5b1bb19eda4769fcbaf80a95c5f0827b7b.png[/img]

[h3]The North Face MTN MIX Basecamp[/h3]

We teamed up with pioneering outdoor brand The North Face to bring you a little piece of chill and coziness called The North Face MTN MIX Basecamp. 🔥 It’s an awesome spot to ride or to relax after hitting Shred’s Gap, our tribute to the iconic Chad’s Gap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/98a1547a31b072df6908a60e1fca834edbb811df.png[/img]

[h3]540INDY Slopestyle 2024[/h3]

We’re thrilled to announce the return of the [url=https://540indy.com/invitational]540INDY Invitational[/url]—Shredders’ official in-game snowboarding contest. For this year’s venue, we switched up the course design with a hybrid concept that showcases as many aspects of snowboarding as possible in one course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/5823b7be2b2b10febbc59532a1a4b988ce7bce87.png[/img]

[h3]A touch of swag…[/h3]

As a little extra, we included two new Nitro snowboards—the 2025 signature models of Shredders’ heroes [b]Marcus Kleveland[/b] and [b]Elias Elhardt[/b]. Join them in new missions to unlock the boards. The brand-new [url=https://540INDY.com/store]540INDY hoodies[/url] also made it to the game.

[h3]…and a lot more love[/h3]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Hotspots: new time attack lines
[*]New builder items—natural & Crater related
[*]New graphics options added (PC only)
[/list]
[b]Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved performance
[*]Maple Acres optimization
[*]Replay editor improvements
[*]Menu navigation improvements
[*]Improved streaming handling to prevent object popping
[*]Increased default hotspot speed limit and tweaked specific ones
[*]Spawning in a session now keeps your stance
[*]Spawn points now display in alphabetical order on the map
[*]Improved Method hand animation
[*]Custom spawn is now saved with location and custom sun setting
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Achievements progression fixes
[*]Mission progression fixes
[*]Fixed control issue when riding out of slippery surface
[*]Lighting issues fix
[*]Maple Acres mission fixes
[*]Prevent gamepad rumble during loadings
[*]Replay editor fixes
[*]Fixed MethodA tutorial/hints not converting to Goofy correctly
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]
The season isn’t over yet. Catch you on the slopes! 🤘

Here's to a kick-ass season, and there’s more in the making.
Stay tuned and see you on the slopes! 🤘

notes.title: 540INDY Invitational
notes.content:
[h3]540INDY Invitational is Shredders’ official in-game snowboarding event, open to all! Ride your steeziest line through the all-new 540INDY Slopestyle course and take home awesome prizes, R-E-S-P-E-C-T, and the title of 540INDY King.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/7b87ce8f80e565f2244d335b7a31df6e117d0246.jpg[/img]

The event will be broadcast online on [b]April 29[/b] and you have a chance to be invited! Just send us a recording of your most stylish & creative run on the 540INDY Slopestyle course. A panel of experts will decide who will be invited to the finals, where you will compete live in front of a top-tier jury of pro snowboarders.
[list]
[*] Film a top-to-bottom run on the 540INDY Slopestyle course. Real-time gameplay, no replay. No cuts, no reshreds, just one continuous run.
[*] Ride the 540INDY Slopestyle as is. No custom features.
[*] When recording, hide the HUD (in Settings). The game’s scoring system is not taken into account for selection.
[*] For PC Shredders: no mods allowed, sorry.
[*] Video specs: 1080p Full HD min 30fps H.264 MP4
[*] One entry per person.
[*] PRO TIP: In the finals, you only have a few attempts to put down your best run. It is advisable to focus on lines you can reproduce with confidence rather than trying tricks you only land once in a million times. It's all about creativity, style, and flow!
[/list]

[b]To enter go to [url=https://shreddersgame.com/invitational]shreddersgame.com/invitational[/url]. Be sure to submit your clip by midnight PST on March 9!
[/b]

notes.title: Shredders Season 2023 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Massive new park[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Peak Park[/b] is a brand new epic snow park waiting for you up in the high mountains of Gnarnia. We’ve got more rails, secret paths, and giant drops than you could ever have hoped for! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/642544390e7347cab05f44ca4f1c7f39feec0f68.gif[/img]

[*] Eight brand [b]new missions[/b] to test you out against the Shredders pro-riders
[/list]
[h2]Huge multiplayer update[/h2]
[list]
[*] With this update you’ll see [b]more riders on the mountain[/b] as we’ve been able to increase public sessions from 6 riders to 10.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/8d7edfa7a0b93772058ecb1dc842b77ed5eae5cb.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Competition time![/b] Take on a new online contest every five minutes to test your Shredders skills with other online players.
[*] [b]Room codes[/b] allow you to easily set up a private mountain between you and others - no matter the platform you’re playing on! PC vs console vs cloud, let’s go!
[*] You can now [b]add your own park features[/b] in private sessions, including kickers, rails and winches - make the mountain yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/9701bce826c6b4ac12966dc80f4f706761ee40c4.gif[/img]

[*] Updated the [b]multiplayer menu[/b] to help explore the mountain with friends, joining hotspots
[*] [b]Teleport and follow[/b] other players while in drone mode, great way to chill out and watch some epic shredding
[/list]
[h2]New moves[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ve added [b]double handed grabs[/b], the epic “Bloody Dracula” and “Rocket Air” moves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851527/b4d2defc8ce00861d60402cf089c2441d140ad73.gif[/img]

[*] Master a new variant for the debatably best trick - [b]the Methoda[/b] - a take on the classic Method but with way more steeze.
[*] [b]Walls[/b] were always great, but now you can RIDE them.
[*] Tweaks to the scoring mechanism for [b]better handling of rails and combos[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Enhanced replay editor[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now [b]record multiple riders[/b] in the same replay - so get your buds together and show us what you’ve got!
[*] Record your best moves in [b]slow motion[/b] (or.. fails!)
[/list]
[h2]Plenty of love under the hood[/h2]
[list]
[*] Plenty of bug fixes
[*] Performance optimization, Shredders is purring better than ever before
[*] We’ve gone through every snowflake, snowmobile, and snowboard to make sure they sound extra snowy. 
[/list]

notes.title: Shredders 1.30 Patch

[*] Subtitle fixes for some cutscenes.
[*] Lighting fixes for the ‘We Own the Sky’ mission.
[*] Other bug fixes and tweaks.
[/list]
We hope to see you on the slopes very soon. Enjoy the game!
